subject.title: [Bug]: Official ClawHub WhatsApp plugin cannot start linked account due to openKeyedStore trust check

question: May OpenClaw trust a workspace-origin candidate for keyed state when it resolves to a recorded official ClawHub install with matching plugin id, package identity, official channel, and install path?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the predicate decides which external plugin code receives host-managed persistent state and channel ingress APIs, so automation should not widen it without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Approve Narrow Provenance Fix
options.body: Allow a focused repair that trusts only path-matched, recorded official ClawHub installs and adds negative tests for raw workspace, load-path, and plugins.allow cases.

options.title: Route Through Broader Trust Design
options.body: Keep this blocked until the wider external-plugin trust model covers workspace/global/root overlap and self-hosted provenance consistently.

options.title: Keep Workspace-Origin Installs Untrusted
options.body: Accept that this install shape remains denied and document a supported reinstall or workspace configuration path instead.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Provenance Fix
recommendation.body: Allow a focused repair that trusts only path-matched, recorded official ClawHub installs and adds negative tests for raw workspace, load-path, and plugins.allow cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent trust-boundary work and maintainer discussion are closest to the policy choice about when external channel plugins may receive trusted state.
